Theme

Latin word

commodus

commodus, commoda, commodum

adjective: with the dative or ad of what it suits

comfortable, convenient, suitable; obliging, agreeable

In this lexicon

    the recommended word · classical · Liv. 22.2.2 (Lewis & Short): longius cēterum commodius iter; Ov. F. 2.288 (Lewis & Short): commoda vestis, of clothes for running; Traupman 294: commodus, comfortable; Traupman 294; Traupman 298
